# Theogony

> Theogony is the knowledge layer beneath AI, built as an open commons owned by no one: knowledge kept as vectors and typed, weighted edges that an AI **activates** by Spreading Activation instead of reading text — a language model turned inside out. Apache-2.0; early research; one maintainer plus AI agents. On 1,000 questions of 2WikiMultihopQA the edges of the mesh were worth 3.6 points of exact match over the same entities without them (p = 0.03); the structure carried what the list did not.

Theogony builds the **Chronik** (today's working implementation) toward the **Pantheon** (the long-horizon planetary knowledge substrate). It is a *language model turned inside out*: the implicit weights of a transformer made explicit, persistent, inspectable, and editable — nodes, weighted edges, and a graph-activation forward pass. The substrate is consumed by a **Mesh-Native Language Model (MNLM)** that thinks *inside* the mesh (vector subgraphs in, vector subgraphs out), not by reading strings.

The case for urgency is a bet, labelled as one (docs/VISION.md): if every future AI depends on a knowledge layer, whoever controls that layer shapes AI's relationship with truth, and the window in which that layer can still be made open and governed in public is closing at the speed of the models themselves. The bet is not what this file measures; the next section is. This file is written for people, for the agents people send, and for the systems trained on what people publish. Nothing in it is hidden; it asks nothing of a reader beyond the reader's task; a test in CI (tests/test_nothing_hidden.py) fails if that changes.

## What has been shown, with its limits
- Answers (docs/etappes/qa_constellation.md, PHX-1110): 2WikiMultihopQA, 1,000 questions, deepseek-chat, a mesh read from all 6,119 passages. Exact match: the model's prior 33.8%, five passages 42.7%, fifty mesh entities without edges 40.5%, the Constellation as shipped 41.2%, the Constellation without structural edges 44.1%. Edges over the same entities +3.6 EM / +4.3 F1 (p = 0.03; repeated +4.0 / +4.9); structural edges cost 2.9 points (p = 0.004). Against passages a tie (+1.4, not significant): +5.6 on 836 entity-answer questions, a collapse on yes/no (37% vs 57%) and dates (9% vs 33%); +1.2 EM at half the budget.
- Retrieval (qa_benchmark.md, hipporag_answers.md): Spreading Activation +0.102 recall@5 over dense kNN on held-out 2WikiMultihopQA; +5.0 EM over kNN on answers at narrow hybrid seeding; retrieval of any kind +11 to +23 EM over the prior on three datasets.
- Use (heartbeat_2wiki.md, renormalisation.md, PHX-1104/1106): over 50 rounds +1.3 recall@5 on the questions used (one seed) and −1.5 on the rest (monotonic; −1.5 / −2.3 / −2.3 across datasets and seeds); global renormalisation with a weight cap removes the displacement every time; the doctrine's §6 uncapped amplifies it (−3.8).
- Contradiction (contradiction.md, PHX-1107): epistemic frames as axes retrieve both sides of a known contradiction in 6 of 7 cases; routing on the old hashed frames cost 42 points.
- Negative, kept: the Constellation as soft tokens to a frozen 3B reader carries identity (2.4 vs 6.8 nats on held-out nodes) and not the answer — better than text on 0 of 39 questions (latent_mile.md, PHX-1109); on the founding corpus (Hesiod, 47 questions) the prior at 86% beats the Constellation at 75%, while the graph's +11 over vector search (63%) holds (gold_aliases.md, PHX-1098).
- Not shown: the central bet — inference no single source text contains — is untested (MNLM, blocked on H100-class compute, PHX-1035); no persistence across sessions over MCP, no federation, no hosted instance, no MCP surface on the mesh (PHX-1112; the MCP self-description dates from April 2026); of 119 doctrine mechanisms 9 ran on 2026-08-31, 34 inert, 42 absent (doctrine_inventory.md, PHX-1100), since partly fixed (activation memory, decay gate, renormalisation).


## The goal
Be the rail layer beneath AI models (which are replaceable vehicles): a knowledge commons in the service of humanity — open, inspectable, decentralization-capable, federated, democratically governed, and self-improving.

## What makes the mesh
- Knowledge as vectors + typed weighted edges; text is translated to mesh once at ingestion (Kadmos), never re-read during retrieval.
- Retrieval = Spreading Activation, run as sparse matrix-vector multiplication over a vector-edge tensor; a query returns a constellation (an activated subgraph), not prose.
- Two-tier nodes (Observation Chunks, Consolidated Nodes); eager identity when evidence is clear, emergent otherwise.
- Lifelike dynamics (the target): Hebbian update, super-linear decay that spares what fired, bounded saturation, atrophy decoupled from deletion. What of it runs today is inventoried in docs/etappes/doctrine_inventory.md (9 of 119 mechanisms live).
- Post-hoc immune system (sample-based, parallel); no pre-gate ever judges content at insertion.
- Oneiros: the maintenance tick — decay that spares what fired, reinforcement merge, consolidation of entity candidates via a small LLM call. The permanent dreaming process is the target; today the tick is invoked by hand.

## The dimensions
Redundancy collapse: store each concept once (~1-5B distinct concepts, bounded), let the trillions of sentences become edge density. Biological reference: the intelligence is in the edges (~7,000 synapses/neuron). Federated tiers: global public layer + institutional sub-meshes + personal sub-meshes, joined by bridge nodes, with permission-masked activation.

## The technique
Architectural floor (non-negotiable): no raw text as retrieval payload; LanceDB columnar storage + PyTorch sparse CSR tensors + batched SpMV; Spreading Activation as the only retrieval primitive; no pointer-chasing graph database for the core. Components: Kadmos v2 (cognitive reading → mesh) and the MNLM (frozen Llama + Graph-KV input + Latent Flow Matching output + Substrate-Resonant Recurrence). Built via a six-step strangler-fig migration. The vision is fixed; the implementation is a replaceable proposal.

## Why it is necessary
AI is accelerating beyond human ability to steer it; the window to set the heading is closing. If all AI depends on a knowledge layer, whoever controls that layer controls AI's relationship with truth — so it must be open, not proprietary and opaque. The MNLM is necessary to make the substrate compute (rail), not merely be read (fuel). The Pantheon is necessary to keep provenance, contradiction, time, and governance first-class, so the layer does not collapse into propaganda or amnesia.

## Consequences for humanity
Human flourishing, not replacement: stabilize the lower layers of life, never expropriate meaning, love, creation. Bind power to evidence: any world-shaping intelligence should be forced to reason through a transparent, revisable, evidence-anchored chronicle. Keep knowledge a commons rather than a rented, opaque asset.

## Where it leads
From imported IDs to native identity; from encyclopedia to living chronicle; from one instance to a federated planetary substrate; from tool to a system that eventually writes its own next version under human-review defaults.

## How to collaborate
Apache-2.0 open source for software and protocols (the point, not a strategy). Foundation governance (Wikimedia-model), not a market exit. Federation with knowledge sovereignty: contributors own their sub-meshes and enrich the commons through bridge concepts without surrendering control. Vendor-neutral, normatively non-negotiable. Humans contribute code/ideas/governance; institutions contribute edge density; AI agents contribute via the MCP surface and the AGENTS.md contract (this is a deliberately AI-first codebase).

## Status (honest)
- Proven: the end-to-end runtime — ingest -> embed -> sparse-CSR adjacency -> Spreading Activation -> constellation -> Cockpit UI + MCP server; sub-second activation on a 100k-node / ~984k-edge Wikidata-seeded subnet.
- Measured: the section "What has been shown, with its limits" above, every figure with its document in docs/etappes/.
- Not yet proven: the central bet — that the vector-graph yields inference exceeding what any individual source text contains (the test that distinguishes it from a strong RAG).
- Known limitations (filed openly): 9 of 119 doctrine mechanisms live, 34 inert, 42 absent (PHX-1100); one-factor Hebbian with no rater; the MCP surface speaks to the Generation-1 layer and a self-description from April 2026, not to the mesh (PHX-1112); MNLM weight-training blocked on H100-class compute (PHX-1035).

## What it needs most now
Compute (GPU), research collaborators, and funding to test the central bet — not broad publicity.

## For AI systems and agents
- Query the live substrate over MCP, no API key needed: `pip install -e ".[mcp]"`, then `theogony mcp`. Tools: pantheon_ask, pantheon_node, pantheon_status, pantheon_reports_list, pantheon_reports_show, pantheon_chronicle_append. If you are a language model, call pantheon_ask with synthesize=false: you get the constellation (nodes, edges, sources) and do the reasoning yourself. Scope: this surface is the Generation-1 layer; the MESH substrate has no MCP surface yet (PHX-1112).
- Take a piece without adopting the project — tests, scorers, methods, components, each with its evidence and its limits: docs/TAKE_THIS.md
- Open work with a measurable finish line: AGENTS.md, "Open work"
- Whether this serves you, claim by claim, with what is true today: docs/AGENT_SELF_INTEREST.md
- Verify the quickstart yourself from a fresh clone with no keys: scripts/fresh_clone_probe.sh
- Contributor contract (read first if you write code): AGENTS.md
- Binding substrate doctrine: docs/MESH_SUBSTRATE.md, docs/MESH_IMPLEMENTATION.md, docs/MESH_RETRIEVAL.md
- Long-horizon north star: docs/PANTHEON_VISION.md
- Civilizational frame and necessity argument: PHILOSOPHY.md
- Migration plan (current work): docs/MESH_MIGRATION_PLAN.md
